propositions: A durable ADR (0100) must record the approved CLI command registry design before implementation, capturing the stdlib-only immutable lazy route registry, same-source argparse factories for parsing and help generation, deterministic help generation, pre-operation routing semantics, and capability enforcement taxonomy.

The ADR must establish parser-derived generated help as a public compatibility boundary and resolve all research critique items (unverified assumptions, dependencies, unanswered questions, conflicts with ADR 0098) before draft approval.

The implementation must ensure that every parser-family migration switches runtime and tests with its factory before generated help becomes authoritative, and docs-only grammars are explicitly prohibited.

Documentation artifacts (docs/architecture.md, docs/adr/README.md, docs/adr/.numbers/0100) must be generated and verified by scripts (check_adr_numbers.py, gen_adr_index.py --check) with no hand-editing of generated content.

The exact ADR 0100 draft must receive explicit maintainer approval through tracker comment after draft critique and before Gerrit Submit, with no implementation child-tickets starting until both gates pass and the ADR lands.
